body:
### Highlights

#### DSv2 and catalog APIs

  - Spark 4.2: Set Iceberg field IDs as Spark column IDs for DSv2 validation ([#17958](https://github.com/apache/iceberg/pull/17958))

      - *Feature: Iceberg field IDs are exposed as DSv2 column IDs, so Spark 4.2's column-ID validation for nested fields works on Iceberg tables.*
  - Spark 4.2: Forward parseRoutineParam and parseQuery to the delegate parser ([#18702](https://github.com/apache/iceberg/pull/18702))

      - *Bug fix:* *CREATE FUNCTION* *with parameters works when the Iceberg SQL extensions are registered, and non-query text is no longer accepted as a query. Backported to 4.0 and 4.1 (*[*#18718*](https://github.com/apache/iceberg/pull/18718)*).*
  - Core, Spark: Rethrow ValidationException from REST 400 responses ([#18473](https://github.com/apache/iceberg/pull/18473))

      - *Bug fix: a server-side validation error reaches Spark as* *ValidationException* *with the REST catalog, the same as with Hive or Hadoop catalogs.*

#### Write path and DML

  - Spark: Emit geometry bounds in Parquet writers ([#18501](https://github.com/apache/iceberg/pull/18501))

      - *Feature: Spark 4.1 and 4.2 Parquet writers record XY bounds for geometry columns, which spatial file pruning needs.*
  - ORC: Fix NPE when reading/writing variant type with ORC format ([#18387](https://github.com/apache/iceberg/pull/18387))

      - *Bug fix: writing a variant to an ORC v3 table fails with a clear "not supported" error instead of a NullPointerException.*

#### Reads, pushdown and vectorization

  - Spark 4.2: Support iterative runtime filtering with PartitionPredicate ([#18600](https://github.com/apache/iceberg/pull/18600))

      - *Performance: runtime filters with no V2 translation, such as dynamic partition pruning or* *part RLIKE (SELECT ...)**, now prune partitions. Identity transforms only.*
  - Arrow, Spark: Skip unprojected shredded variants in vectorized Parquet reads ([#18434](https://github.com/apache/iceberg/pull/18434))

      - *Bug fix: a vectorized query that does not select a shredded variant column no longer fails.*
  - Spark 3.5, 4.0, 4.1, 4.2: Use scan schema for CBO column statistics ([#18655](https://github.com/apache/iceberg/pull/18655))

      - *Bug fix: column statistics from Puffin files map to the scan's column names, so CBO no longer fails or mismatches after dropped or renamed columns and on time travel. A 3.5-only first fix was* [*#18459*](https://github.com/apache/iceberg/pull/18459)*.*

#### Views, metrics and other

  - Spark 4.1: Add per-task scanDuration metric ([#17562](https://github.com/apache/iceberg/pull/17562))

      - *Feature: a per-task read-time metric (total, min, median, max) in the Spark UI, so scan throughput can be measured. 4.2 port in* [*#18751*](https://github.com/apache/iceberg/pull/18751)*.*

### Discussion points

1.  **1.13 release.** No RC or 1.13.x branch yet, and the 4.2 tracker is now on the milestone. *Decide: freeze date, and cut a branch at RC.*
2.  **1.12.1?** Two silent-data-loss fixes ([#18005](https://github.com/apache/iceberg/pull/18005), [#18348](https://github.com/apache/iceberg/pull/18348)) are in no release. *Decide: 1.12.1 now, or ship them in 1.13.*
3.  **Spark 4.2 pending items (**[**#17959**](https://github.com/apache/iceberg/issues/17959)**).**

      - Merged: CREATE TABLE LIKE, schema evolution, partition pruning, cache invalidation tests.
      - the DSv2 Transaction API ([#18385](https://github.com/apache/iceberg/pull/18385)) has 0 reviews and closes around Nov 14.
      - *Decide: what gates publishing 4.2, and who owns each missing piece.*
4.  **Spark 4.3: skip, add, or certify 4.2 on it?** [#18749](https://github.com/apache/iceberg/pull/18749) is a 661-file copy. I proposed waiting for 4.4*.*
5.  **Wrong-result bugs need reviewers.**

      - Shared exchange: [#18557](https://github.com/apache/iceberg/pull/18557).
      - DELETE removing NULL rows: [#18617](https://github.com/apache/iceberg/pull/18617).
      - WAP with deletion vectors: [#18824](https://github.com/apache/iceberg/pull/18824).
      - Equality-delete keys: [#18621](https://github.com/apache/iceberg/pull/18621) and [#18622](https://github.com/apache/iceberg/pull/18622).
      - ExpireSnapshots inside a transaction: [#18738](https://github.com/apache/iceberg/pull/18738).
      - *Ask: an owner for each, and which ones block 1.13.*

### Review requests

  - Spark 4.1: Implement SupportsReportOrdering DSv2 API ([#16750](https://github.com/apache/iceberg/pull/16750))

      - *Feature: Iceberg scans tell Spark how their data is sorted, so Spark can skip redundant sorts.*
  - Core, Spark: Add K-way merge rewrite strategy for pre-sorted data files ([#16305](https://github.com/apache/iceberg/pull/16305))

      - *Performance: compaction merges files that are already sorted instead of shuffling and re-sorting them.*
  - Spark: Add selective shredded variant extraction Parquet readers ([#16714](https://github.com/apache/iceberg/pull/16714))

      - *Performance: reads only the requested fields of a shredded variant column.*
  - Parquet: Apply ReadBuilder.set() properties to read options ([#18238](https://github.com/apache/iceberg/pull/18238))

      - *Bug fix: Parquet read options such as vectored I/O take effect, so users can cap read memory (the 1.11 OOM,* [*#16600*](https://github.com/apache/iceberg/issues/16600)*).*
  - Spark 4.2: Compare scans instead of their hash codes in SparkBatch equality ([#18557](https://github.com/apache/iceberg/pull/18557))

      - *Bug fix: scans with different filters no longer share an exchange and return wrong results.*
  - Spark: Preserve NULL semantics in metadata deletes ([#18617](https://github.com/apache/iceberg/pull/18617))

      - *Bug fix: a metadata-only DELETE no longer removes rows whose column is NULL.*
  - API, Core, Spark 4.2: Wire in InputFilesDecryptor into Spark readers ([#18486](https://github.com/apache/iceberg/pull/18486))

      - *Refactor: Spark 4.2 readers decrypt files through the shared InputFilesDecryptor.*
  - Core, Spark: Fix incorrect partial commit failure count in rewrite data files ([#16970](https://github.com/apache/iceberg/pull/16970))

      - *Bug fix:* *rewrite_data_files* *reports the correct number of failed commits with partial progress.*
  - Spark: Use the table's catalog Hadoop configuration when listing orphan files ([#17862](https://github.com/apache/iceberg/pull/17862))

      - *Bug fix:* *remove_orphan_files* *lists files with the catalog's credentials, not the cluster's.*
  - Parquet: Convert TIMESTAMP_MILLIS statistics to micros ([#18321](https://github.com/apache/iceberg/pull/18321))

      - *Bug fix: pruning no longer skips matching rows in Parquet files written by other engines with millisecond timestamps.*
  - Core: Carry forward custom snapshot properties through replace commits ([#18401](https://github.com/apache/iceberg/pull/18401))

      - *Feature: custom snapshot properties survive compaction and other replace commits.*
  - Spark: Support aggregate pushdown for identity partition column GROUP BY ([#16176](https://github.com/apache/iceberg/pull/16176))

      - *Performance: COUNT, MIN and MAX with GROUP BY on identity partition columns are answered from metadata.*
